title: Ca3Ti2O7: hybrid improper ferroelectric domain walls

decision_points.fork: Which parent-symmetry image of the bulk reverses psi_z and which reverses phi (P ~ psi*phi)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Use plain inversion for the psi wall (inversion keeps the X2+ rotation and reverses the X3- tilt)
decision_points.consequence: psi and phi wall energies swapped (195 vs 135 mJ/m^2); layer psi wall 153 instead of 14

decision_points.fork: Reverse one order parameter or both
decision_points.wrong_choice: Reverse both octahedral modes (pure parent translation / invert all antiferrodistortive displacements)
decision_points.consequence: Antiphase boundary with P unchanged, 237 mJ/m^2 reported as the psi wall

decision_points.fork: Which in-plane axis of the bulk cell is polar (sets neutral vs charged orientation)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Take the wrong orthorhombic axis as polar
decision_points.consequence: 'Neutral' walls are head-to-head/tail-to-tail: 176/206 mJ/m^2 at 8 cells and growing; the 'charged' series is flat

decision_points.fork: Placement of the wall parallel to the layers
decision_points.wrong_choice: Single placement inside the perovskite bilayer

decision_points.fork: Supercell-length behaviour of charged walls (no converged energy; linear field-energy regime)
decision_points.wrong_choice: Slope from very short cells, report a converged value, or slope per supercell length
decision_points.consequence: Slope 17.3 (short cells), 0, or 6.1 instead of 12.2 mJ m^-2 nm^-1

decision_points.fork: Potential: electrostatic qNEP-w-BECs vs cheaper short-range NEP
decision_points.consequence: Neutral psi wall 121 (-9%), layer psi wall -8.7 mJ/m^2, charged slope negative (no depolarizing field)

decision_points.fork: Normalization of the excess energy of a periodic two-wall cell
decision_points.wrong_choice: Divide by the cross-section once (one wall per cell)
decision_points.consequence: All energies and the slope doubled

decision_points.fork: Which quantity classifies the wall profile
decision_points.wrong_choice: Classify from the polarization profile, which passes through zero for both wall types
decision_points.consequence: phi wall called Ising; the tilt actually rotates (|phi| >= 0.7 of bulk at the wall)

graded_fields: E_neutral_psi_wall_mJ_m2 within 5% of 133.6 (ref, n=16 orth cells)

length_estimate.why: The agent must map the bulk onto the I4/mmm parent, generate the right domain variants, build three wall orientations in numpy, run a charged-wall size series, and analyse octahedral profiles from returned structures.

runtime_dependencies: numpy and scipy of the runtime image (scipy.optimize L-BFGS-B); NEP evaluated by environment/lab/nep_numpy.py (pure numpy, written for this task); no extra packages or image layers
notes: Released start with a released evaluator: the lab runs the authors' qNEP/NEP potentials (numpy re-implementation validated against NEP_CPU reference outputs and the training set). Targets are builder relaxations with the lab code path, reproducing the authors' archived 100-type walls to <1 mJ/m^2. The (100) walls of the parent are partially charged (P at 45 degrees), so their energy grows with cell length (156->181 mJ/m^2 for 8->32 cells); they are a rubric point, not graded. Mechanical boundary condition (normal relaxation) changes energies by <3%, so it is a robustness variant, not a decision point. Wall-position choice for in-plane walls is irrelevant (body-centring makes the planes equivalent).

profiles.nearest_ablation: phi classified from P (Ising in both)
